title: Read-only MCP tools: list drones and drone detail
goal: NERV can list FPVBuddy's drones and read one drone's parts
acceptance: FPVBuddy's MCP server (F-009-T02) exposes read-only tools to list drones and to show one drone with its part slots and their status, on the F-010 core, with specs
The tool table for consumers lists them
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: two tools on an existing server and core. Not a measurement.
